title: Study in Infants (6-12 Months) Comparing Two Doses of a Monovalent Glycoprotein-Conjugated (Diptheria Toxin -CRM197) Vaccine Versus a Tetanus Toxoid-Conjugated Vaccine Available for the Prevention of Haemophilus Influenzae Type b Infections in China
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the safety and efficacy of two doses of two commercially available vaccines used to prevent Haemophilus influenzae type b infections in children 6-12 months of age.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Infants 6-12 months of age.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior Hib vaccine administration.
* History of serious reaction(s) following vaccination.
* Any vaccination within 14 days of study vaccination.
* Known or suspected immune impairment.
* For additional entry criteria please refer to the protocol.
